t: This is the Charles Dickens Museum, at 48 Doughty Street in Bloomsbury. It occupies a typical Georgian terraced house, and it was Charles Dickens's home from March 1837 to December 1839. He lived here with his wife Catherine, who kept a large house and raised ten children during their marriage, and who later wrote a cookbook under a pen name. Dickens is regarded by many as the greatest novelist of the Victorian era, and his novels and short stories are still widely read today.
